title: Godly Speech
definition: Godly Speech is the use of words in ways that honor God, tell truth, build others up, and reflect a renewed heart.
summary: Godly Speech is the use of words to tell truth, give grace, restrain evil, and build others up before God.
christFocus: Jesus Christ speaks truth and grace, and He teaches His disciples to use words for life rather than destruction.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Godly speech is the use of words in a way that honors God and builds others up. Scripture treats the tongue as spiritually serious because words can heal, teach, bless, deceive, wound, or destroy.

Godly speech is not merely avoiding profanity. It includes truthfulness, gentleness, encouragement, correction, restraint, and refusing gossip or slander.

Jesus spoke with perfect truth and grace. His people are called to let their words reflect His character and serve His purposes.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because words often reveal what rules the heart. Godly speech corrects careless talk, online cruelty, gossip, manipulation, and flattery by placing every word under Christ's lordship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Before speaking, ask whether your words are true, necessary, loving, and timely. Repent quickly when your speech wounds, and practice using words to strengthen faith and honor Christ.
